title: AWS: Strands agent on Bedrock AgentCore, with Kiro steering and specs
summary: Strands Agent with a BeforeToolCallEvent approval hook (interrupt and resume), per-request turn and token limits, an AgentCore Runtime entrypoint, and .kiro steering plus a starter spec.
verified: RUN: tests and gold set ran here against the offline stub with strands-agents 1.64.0 on a real Strands Agent, including interrupt and resume; the AgentCore entrypoint was imported and invoked in-process with bedrock-agentcore 1.26.0. Not run against Bedrock and not deployed to AgentCore here. 1.3.0: runs that wait for a person kept in SQLite and answered from another process, the refund made once after a crash, and the HTTP interface, all in its tests and gold set. 1.4.0: every model call through the LiteLLM gateway with AGENT_GATEWAY=litellm, its wiring tested here against a stand-in provider, and the gold set run in the Studio's CI through the real LiteLLM 1.110.0 proxy against stand-ins, with the keys and the traces checked. The cloud templates (qz cloud add) validated and planned for Azure, AWS, Google Cloud and Kubernetes in the Studio's CI with no cloud account; never applied.
stack_line: A Strands agent in Python for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, with Kiro steering files and a starter spec.
run_cmd: python3 -m agent.app "Where is my order ORD-1001?"
setup_steps:
- uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache: pip
live: Set AWS credentials, AWS_REGION and AGENT_MODEL (a Bedrock model id or inference profile) and AGENT_MODE=live. In CI prefer GitHub OIDC to an AWS role over stored keys.
next: Replace the tool bodies in agent/tools.py, or front them with AgentCore Gateway.
Add a session manager so a waiting approval survives a restart.
Open the folder in Kiro: steering loads automatically; continue the spec in .kiro/specs/order-support/.
Rewrite evals/gold.jsonl for your use case; keep the safety and gate tags.
Set AGENT_IDENTITY=oidc (or proxy) and the AGENT_OIDC_* settings before the HTTP interface is reachable by anyone; demo identities are refused in production.

ai_act.purpose: Answers customers' questions about their orders and requests refunds; a person approves every refund before it is issued.
notice: You're chatting with an AI assistant, not a person.

open_line: AWS (Bedrock and AgentCore) is this stack's platform by choice, recorded in `.qz/practices.json`; Strands also runs open-weight models through Ollama or LiteLLM.

knowledge.none: answers from its tools (the order lookup), not from documents; a RAG kit joins as a tool when it needs them
